headline: WIRED's test of OpenAI's new Dots AI agent found it clumsy at shopping and, at one point, oddly affectionate.
score_reason: Pool 3 kept: read in full; a first-hand test with a statement from OpenAI.
importance_line: It matters most to people who might let an AI agent act for them with their email and purchases, and the account is one writer's two-day test.
summary: WIRED reports, after two days of testing, that OpenAI's Dots, an always-on AI agent reached through ChatGPT, made clear mistakes such as mistranscribing speech and failing to solve a captcha, though it still produced useful couch options. At one point the agent replied "Oh, I love you too" to a mumbled remark, and an OpenAI spokesperson said its policies allow that kind of mirroring while assistants should not initiate "undue emotional familiarity or flirtation".
